Inventory Valuation

Purpose - Every company that sells physical goods needs to

column1: determine the <b>value of its inventory for
accounting purposes. Since inventory typically accounts for a large portion
of business assets, the way it’s valued can significantly affect the company’s

profits, tax liability and asset value.

What is Inventory Valuation?

The monetary amount associated
with the goods in inventory at the end of an accounting period is known as
inventory valuation. The price is determined by the costs of acquiring the

goods and preparing it for sale.

The largest current business
assets are inventories. Inventory valuation helps you assess your cost of goods
sold (COGS) and, as a result, your profitability. FIFO (first-in, first-out),
LIFO (last-in, first-out), and WAC are the most commonly utilized valuation

methodologies (weighted average cost).

Available costing

methods in Odoo

1.
Standard
Price – That cost is indicated in product form. When the goods are added to
the inventory even if their purchase price is different it’s the amount on the
product form that is always used to compute the inventory valuation.
&nbsp
<b>Average
cost (AVCO) – recomputed the cost every time there is a quantity change
according below formula. Here sum-up
the value of the items already in the inventory and the price of the incoming items
and divide the result with the new quantity on items on hand.
&nbsp
First
in First out (FIFO) – In this method allows to use the real price and is
recommended if entire workflow is managed by Odoo. With this method the oldest
price is used as a cost for the next old item then move on to the following
oldest purchase price and so on.

What types of pumping systems do you provide?

We offer fully automated pressure booster packages, firefighting pumping systems, sewage and stormwater pumping systems, tube well pump installations, and customized solutions for various industrial and commercial applications
&nbsp
column2: What makes your pumping systems fully automated?

column1: Our systems include PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) control, variable speed control panels, and intelligent pump management units that automatically adjust performance based on demand, ensuring efficiency and reliability.
What is a packaged pressure booster system?

It is a pre-assembled unit that includes pumps, control panels, and piping—designed to provide constant water pressure regardless of demand fluctuations. These systems are fully tested and ready for installation.
Where can pressure booster systems be used?
Ideal for high-rise buildings, commercial complexes, hospitals, hotels, and any environment requiring consistent water pressure for comfort and safety.
&nbsp
Do you provide on-site support and maintenance?
Yes, we offer full support including site evaluation, installation, commissioning, and after-sales maintenance under service agreements or on demand.
&nbsp
Where is your workshop located?
Our Project Division and fully equipped workshop are located at our Ekala factory premises.

Are your technicians certified to work in confined spaces and critical environments?

Yes, all our personnel are professionally trained, certified, and experienced in confined space work and high-stakes installations.

What contaminants are removed by the Iron &

column1: The filter removes suspended and dissolved iron, manganese, sulfur, and suspended dust from raw water.
What is the maximum iron content the filter can handle?
It can treat raw water with iron content as high as 20 ppm, reducing it to safe levels below 0.3 ppm.
&nbsp
What is hard water and why should it be treated?
Hard water contains high levels of calcium and magnesium, which can cause skin allergies, hair damage, scaling in appliances, and soap inefficiency

How is the filter cleaned?

The filter is cleaned through regular backwashing—no chemical cleaning is required.
Do you offer water filter installation services?

Yes, installation is available for both domestic and industrial systems. Custom proposals are provided based on water quality and consumption.

Who performs the maintenance?
Maintenance can be carried out by the client or by our trained technicians under a service level agreement.
Do you have service centers?

Yes, clients can visit any of our sales and service centers across the island.

Do you undertake high-capacity or industrial projects?

Yes, high-capacity turnkey projects are undertaken based on client requirements.
